Dove si trova la polmonite? Guarda anche: Where is the pneumonia? Look behind the heart too.
Dietro il cuore c'è una parte del lobo i: Behind the heart lies part of the left lower lobe, which on a PA or AP is seen only through the cardiac silhouette: it is one of the hidden areas. Compare the density of the heart on the two sides of the spine and look for the outline of the descending aorta and the medial left hemidiaphragm: if they disappear (silhouette sign) there is an opacity in contact. In children the projection is often AP and the heart looks larger; in the youngest the thymus can mimic a mediastinal opacity. The lateral view, when available, shows the consolidation above the diaphragm, behind the heart. A follow-up X-ray after uncomplicated pneumonia in a child is not needed if the clinical course is good.
